Customs Act 1969: This act provides the enabling authority under Section 25(3) for the government to issue and amend statutory notifications related to customs valuations.
S.R.O. 146-AIN/2013: This specific customs notification is being amended to remove certain entries from its regulatory schedule.
TABLE-2: The entries corresponding to the specified heading in this table are repealed, effectively removing the associated customs treatment for those specific items.
S.R.O. 142-AIN/2015: This notification serves as the legal instrument to formally amend the prior S.R.O. 146-AIN/2013 by deleting specific tariff headings and their associated data from the table.
